body:
Adds `research/eda-proposers`: random, grid, annealing, GA, NSGA-II and TPE compared at equal evaluation budgets by Pareto hypervolume (100 seeds) on an 80-design space built from `eda-harness`'s log plus `abc -fast` rows. Stylised, tiny space, untuned; README states limits. 10 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Also closes superseded branch `ecstatic-lamport-tevell` (selfrep-termsat duplicates selfrep-terminalmarket on main).
